annotations.title: Add a sync point at a word + timestamp

description:
Insert one sync marker on a clip's transcript.

Use this when:
- The user is explicit about WHERE the camera should pause / cut (e.g. "sync the word 'submit' to 4.2s of the demo").
- `auto_sync` ran but missed a step you care about.

How matching works:
- `word`: case-insensitive; punctuation and apostrophe style don't matter ("here's" matches "Here’s,").
- `occurrence`: 1-indexed, to pin a repeated word by count. Omit it and the occurrence spoken nearest `timestamp_seconds` is used (the first one when the clip has no word timings yet); the reply says which (`occurrence`, `occurrence_chosen_by`).
- `timestamp_seconds`: clip-relative seconds, measured from the clip's OWN start (a split clip's right half starts at 0 too). The server maps it to original-recording seconds: through the TTS retime when the clip has run TTS, plus the clip's source in-point. The reply's `timestamp_seconds_original` is that recording second and `source_start_seconds` the in-point; `mapped_from_generated` is true only when a TTS retime actually moved the value.

Constraints: the clip MUST be a video clip with a source recording; a slide or blank clip answers `not_a_video_clip`. The transcript must already contain the word — if not, you'll get `word_not_found` with a 200-char excerpt of the transcript and `close_matches` to retry with. The reply's `order` is the new marker's number: the N of its `<SYNC_MARKER N>` in voiceover_text, what get_clip(select:['sync_points']) lists and what remove_sync_point takes. `warnings` flags a marker already on that word (stacked markers leave no speech between them: remove one or pick another word) and a timestamp outside the clip's source range.

clip_id.description: Clip ID (preferred). If omitted, clip_index is used.

clip_index.description: Zero-based clip index. Ignored if clip_id is provided.

occurrence.description: 1-indexed match number when the word repeats. Omit to use the occurrence spoken nearest timestamp_seconds.

sync_point_name.description: Optional label (e.g. 'Click submit'). Defaults to 'Sync point N' using the next order number.

timestamp_seconds.description: Clip-relative timestamp in seconds. Auto-mapped to original-recording seconds when the clip has generated_timestamps.

word.description: Target word (case-insensitive; trailing punctuation is stripped).

name: add_sync_point
title: Add a sync point at a word + timestamp
